title: Application inutile pour un compte non premium
body:
On installe, on créé un compte via l'application qui nous amène sur le site internet. OK.

Compte créé. Mais inutilisable....sur l'application. Oui, c'est seulement pour les comptes premium. Comment le devenir si on ne teste même pas ? 

Bref, aussitôt installée aussitôt supprimée. Demande de suppression de mes données également.
author: Habanerodulce

title: Genuinely helps
body: No idea what I exactly like about dailyhabits.xyz but being able to make complete use of the tool  (and serve the purpose) within 1 minute of signing up is truly amazing. As this only requires less than 10seconds of attention per day, it’s pretty convenient for someone like me who usually fools himself into thinking that “I cannot follow through on yet another new thing because it’s too much commitment and I already have a infinite amount of tasks which require my attention and I’ve not started on it, yet.”
author: PhoenixIsoYoru

title: App exclusive for paid users
body:
Found this app while searching for an Habit tracker.

Upon installing, it asked to create an account. After creating an account, you realise the app is for paid users. 

Would have appreciated a heads up before I created the account.

author: Ash_9988771

title: Straightforward and clean
body: This app does the job without clutter! DailyHabits helps me monitor progress in building new habits and breaking others. I love the clean appearance, the day/night mode and how reinforcing it is to check a box. I don’t want reminders or character graphics—just a digital tracker and DailyHabits is perfect! Customer service was fantastic when I made a silly log-in error. I also appreciate the one-time payment for premium rather than a subscription.
author: Scarlet Robin

title: Can’t access
body: Read a glowing review about this app. Downloaded. App asks to log in even though it’s the first time I’ve used it. Upon clicking “forgot password” I get to a webpage that lets me create a new account. Ok. Created new account. Set up some habits. Interface is nice and simple. Closed the webpage. Go back to app. Log in with newly created account. Get error message that only paid users get access to the app. Huh??
